SHARED-SCREEN FALLBACK
======================

The file in this folder is the same two-player game WITHOUT own screens:
both PCs show one picture, player 1's camera. Everything else is the same.

Use it only if the own screens give trouble (wrong picture, very slow, a crash).

How, on BOTH PCs (the two files must be the same on both, or joining is refused):
1. Close the game.
2. Copy  SLPM-66675_F266B00B.pnach  from this folder into  emulator\patches
   and let it replace the file of the same name there.
3. Start again with START-KH2-TEST.bat.

To go back to own screens: unzip the friend kit again (friend), or ask for the package again (host).
The save file stays usable either way.
